summary.prose: Make every generated companion HTML (ER, UX mock, sequence, component-dependency) self-explanatory without opening the source markdown. Reuse the docgen shell's existing narrative-section band: each definition->IR mapper now emits a reader-facing 'Purpose' section, per-element schema/field explanations, and a legend into narrated.sections (previously empty), so the primary shell renders them for free. Add ONE additive optional field, narrated.sourceLink {label, href}, rendered as an escaped <a> in both the primary and the oversized-fallback shells (closing the fallback's parity gap), and thread the sibling artifact .md link (./HLD.md / ./LLD.md) from the finalize wiring. A plain docgen document with empty sections and no sourceLink renders byte-identically to today.

hldContextSlice.framework: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Designed directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes; there are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

api.name: erDefinitionToIr

parameters.name: erDef
parameters.purpose: The authored ER model; the mapper already parses its classes/attributes/ranges to build the diagram nodes/edges and now ALSO derives the context sections from the same parse.

returns.meaning: Unchanged type. NEW: narrated.sections is now populated (previously []) with a 'Purpose' section + a per-class field-explanation section (each attribute: name, range, required/identifier, and crow's-foot relationship meaning) + a 'Legend' section. derived nodes/edges + scopeDescription unchanged. The 3 sibling mappers (uxDefinitionToIr, sequenceDefinitionToIr, componentDependencyDefinitionToIr) mirror this per-kind.

errors.condition: Unchanged — a dangling relationship range still throws; the section build reuses the already-validated parse.

preconditions: The definition has already passed its validator (finalize gate).
postconditions: narrated.sections is non-empty for a well-formed definition; the derived diagram content is unchanged.
The stored/in-body definition is not mutated (read-only derivation).

dataModelChanges.details: Add an additive optional readonly sourceLink?: { readonly label: string; readonly href: string } to NarratedContent. Rendered as an escaped <a> in buildHtml + assembleFallbackShell; absent -> no link (byte-identical). Additionally the four companion toIr mappers now POPULATE narrated.sections (purpose + field-explanations + legend) instead of leaving it []. No field removed or renamed; a plain docgen document that sets neither is unchanged.
dataModelChanges.schemaDiff: interface NarratedContent { readonly sections: readonly IrSection[]; readonly sourceLink?: { readonly label: string; readonly href: string } | undefined; }

dataModelChanges.details: Previously every companion toIr returned narrated:{sections:[]} (diagram-only HTML). Now each mapper populates narrated.sections with a 'Purpose' + per-element field-explanation + 'Legend' section, derived read-only from the same definition parse that builds the diagram. Changes rendered companion HTML but not the derived diagram nodes/edges; a docgen document that still emits empty sections is unaffected. renderNarrative escape/offline invariants preserved.

errorCases.scenario: assembleShell returns a non-ok DocGenOutcome for a valid companion definition (oversized diagram with no subprocess renderer, or missing inlined runtime asset).

errorCases.response: Throw DiagramGenerationError and write no file. Context sections are built in-IR before assembleShell so they never partially write.
errorCases.userImpact: Companion HTML not produced; finalize swallows the DiagramGenerationError with a warn (unchanged) and the .md is still written without that companion link.

errorCases.scenario: A companion definition is malformed (HIGH-severity validator finding).

errorCases.response: finalize returns {ok:false, failure}; the synth turn is retried; enrichment never reached for an invalid definition.
errorCases.userImpact: The author is asked to fix the definition (retry loop); no half-enriched HTML is emitted.

migration.stateBefore: Companion HTML is diagram-only: toIr mappers return narrated:{sections:[]}; DocumentIR.narrated has no back-reference field; assembleFallbackShell renders only the svg. Grounded in s1 (shell.ts:189/204, render.ts:65, fallback.ts:200, er.ts).
migration.stateAfter: toIr populates narrated.sections (Purpose+field+Legend); DocumentIR.narrated carries additive-optional sourceLink; buildHtml + assembleFallbackShell render it + the band (parity); renderXCompanion opts + finalize helpers thread the sibling-.md link. Plain docgen documents byte-identical.

migrationSteps.action: Add additive optional sourceLink {label, href} to NarratedContent on DocumentIR (types.ts).
Extend renderNarrative + buildHtml to render the optional sourceLink as an escaped <a>, preserving empty-case byte-identity.
Bring assembleFallbackShell to parity (render band + escaped link), guarded for empty-case byte-identity.
Populate narrated.sections in the four companion toIr mappers (Purpose + field-explanation + Legend), read-only.
Add optional sourceLink to the four renderXCompanion opts; set onto ir.narrated.sourceLink before assembleShell.
Thread the sibling-.md relative link from the orchestrator finalize helpers using the .md path already in scope.
Extend unit + finalize-integration tests (byte-identity, link rendering, per-kind sections, finalize assertions).

migration.backwardCompat: buildHtml/assembleFallbackShell are internal render functions; buildHtml gains an appended optional param and the renderXCompanion opts gain an optional field — every existing caller that omits them compiles and behaves as before. DocumentIR.narrated.sourceLink is additive-optional. Only observable change is richer companion HTML; a plain docgen document renders byte-identically and already-generated files are unaffected (regenerated on next finalize).

alternativesConsidered.title: Reuse the existing narrative band + add narrated.sourceLink
alternativesConsidered.description: Populate narrated.sections in each toIr (Purpose + field-explanation + Legend) so the existing renderNarrative band renders them for free; add one additive optional narrated.sourceLink rendered as an escaped <a> in buildHtml AND assembleFallbackShell (parity); thread the sibling-.md link from the finalize helpers.
pros: Reuses the shell's proven narrative band + escape/offline invariants
One additive-optional field; byte-identical for plain docgen docs
Field explanations live in the mappers that already own the definition semantics
cons: Touches the fallback shell to reach parity
Section content is prose, not a structured table

alternativesConsidered.title: Dedicated ContextPanel component in the shell
alternativesConsidered.description: Introduce a new structured context/legend panel type in the shell separate from narrated.sections, with its own template + styles.
cons: New shell surface + template + styles to maintain
Higher byte-identity/regression risk on the shared shell

alternativesConsidered.title: Generic IR-derived context from derived.nodes/edges only
alternativesConsidered.description: Build context sections generically in the shell from ir.derived (nodes/edges) instead of per-kind in the mappers.
pros: Single code path, no per-kind mapper edits
cons: Loses per-kind semantics (crow's-foot meaning, UX roles, message kinds)
Field/schema explanations not recoverable from generic nodes/edges
Weakest on the userValue's schema/field-explanation requirement
